intent: New perspective concept sheets; approval before runtime production

prompts.i_prelevement:
Use case: stylized-concept. NEW perspective VFX approval sheet for Catabase, an isometric tactical turn-based fantasy game. Drawn production proposal, NOT a screenshot. Landscape 1536x1024 on warm pale parchment. Crisp ink contours, premium cel animation, 2–3 flat values, strong asymmetric silhouettes, saturated accents, no blurry bloom or photorealism. Buildable with a few faceted Blender meshes and short sprite clips. Consistent high-three-quarter orthographic view of stone grid tiles seen as diamonds. Full-body graceful adult human mannequins for scale: protagonist desaturated jade short cloak, enemy muted rust sash. Effects more saturated than setting. Three large chronological panels across the top, same camera/scale, shallow design detail strip below, generous negative space. Exact quoted French labels. No duplicate ghosts, generic particle cloud or damage numbers except requested.
Title "I — Prélèvement". Subtitle "EXTRAIRE · RAMENER · RECEVOIR". Exactly one hero and one enemy per panel, standing two cells apart: hero foreground-left, enemy background-right. Positions fixed throughout.
Panel 1 "01 · Prise": three small curved aubergine-black talon petals close at enemy torso around ONE faceted coral-red lozenge of magical energy, with a single ivory incision contact. Spell shape, no monster or extra hand. Compact, under half enemy height. No blood, wounds, tentacles or distortion.
Panel 2 "02 · Retour": petals gone. ONE coral energy lozenge travels from ENEMY TO HERO along a thin elegant curved burgundy-coral ribbon. Thin tail at enemy, bright leading head close to hero. Neither figure moves. No laser, lightning, orbiting ring or unrelated target.
Panel 3 "03 · Soin reçu": connecting ribbon gone. At hero chest the lozenge opens into TWO jade-green curved leaves with warm ivory center, a satisfying compact inward gathering shape that vanishes quickly. Enemy remains at same place without status icon. Face and feet visible. No giant aura.
Bottom strip: extraction petals enlarged, travel lozenge with tapered tail, two-leaf reception. Four swatches aubergine #40273e, coral #ed6553, jade #76cba3, ivory #fff0ce.
Footer "Retour et soin seulement si des PV sont récupérés". Tight sharp extraction, fluid return, compact reception. No UI bars, necromancer skulls or persistent mark.
prompts.j_convergence:
Use case: stylized-concept. NEW perspective VFX approval sheet for Catabase, an isometric tactical turn-based fantasy game. Drawn production proposal, NOT a screenshot. Landscape 1536x1024 on warm pale parchment. Crisp ink contours, premium cel animation, 2–3 flat values, strong asymmetric silhouettes, saturated accents, no blurry bloom or photorealism. Buildable with a few faceted Blender meshes and short sprite clips. Consistent high-three-quarter orthographic view of stone grid tiles seen as diamonds. Full-body graceful adult human mannequins for scale: protagonist desaturated jade short cloak, enemy muted rust sash. Effects more saturated than setting. Three large chronological panels across the top, same camera/scale, shallow design detail strip below, generous negative space. Exact quoted French labels. No duplicate ghosts, generic particle cloud or damage numbers except requested.
Title "J — Convergence". Subtitle "ATTIRER · COMPRIMER · FRAPPER".
Spell center is an EMPTY tile marked by a little ivory diamond. Hero three tiles away foreground-left, outside damage cross, intact. Exactly THREE enemies each panel. In panel 1 enemies two grid steps from center on three different grid axes; in panels 2–3 each ONE grid step closer, on three arms of the cross. A grid axis is diagonal in isometric projection. No diagonal movement across world grid, no stacking bodies on a tile.
Panel 1 "01 · Appel": FOUR thick indigo-violet curved wedge petals turn inward immediately above empty center at ankle height. Small ivory diamond in middle. Inward tension, no tornado/black hole/damage burst. Enemies at initial tiles.
Panel 2 "02 · Attraction": the same enemies now exactly ONE tile closer; three narrow short streaks behind heels show accepted movement, no duplicate bodies. Four petals tightly folded into a dense violet/ivory angular knot on still-empty center. Character scale preserved. Hero untouched.
Panel 3 "03 · Croix d’impact": central knot opens into FOUR short broad violet blades along the FOUR WORLD-GRID directions, forming an isometric plus, not an X cutting across the grid. Ivory edges stop inside center+four neighbor tiles. Compact cream contact stars ONLY at the three enemies on occupied arms. One hit per enemy. No circle of damage, no hero impact, center still empty, positions unchanged from panel 2.
Bottom strip has TWO separate small top-down annotated rule diagrams, not gameplay effects. "Attraction · rayon 2": square 5x5 grid with diamond selection row counts 1,3,5,3,1. "Frappe · croix": square 3x3 grid with five selected cells forming a plus. Enlarged four-petal knot beside them and swatches indigo #29283f, violet #7657b5, lilac #c8a6eb, ivory #fff0cc.
Footer "Un pas accepté · un impact par cible · aucune zone durable". Attraction radius and damage cross differ. One contraction/release, no lingering portal, suction or rubble.
prompts.k_decret_dernier_souffle:
Use case: stylized-concept. NEW perspective VFX approval sheet for Catabase, an isometric tactical turn-based fantasy game. Drawn production proposal, NOT a screenshot. Landscape 1536x1024 on warm pale parchment. Crisp ink contours, premium cel animation, 2–3 flat values, strong asymmetric silhouettes, saturated accents, no blurry bloom or photorealism. Buildable with a few faceted Blender meshes and short sprite clips. Consistent high-three-quarter orthographic view of stone grid tiles seen as diamonds. Full-body graceful adult human mannequins for scale: protagonist desaturated jade short cloak, enemy muted rust sash. Effects more saturated than setting. Three large chronological panels across the top, same camera/scale, shallow design detail strip below, generous negative space. Exact quoted French labels. No duplicate ghosts, generic particle cloud or damage numbers except requested.
Title "K — Décret du dernier souffle". Subtitle "ARMER · ATTENDRE · SURVIVRE".
Same hero posture and tile in all panels. A single rust-sash enemy adjacent in each main panel, illustrating one possible lethal strike. Divine protection consumed once, NOT healing, immortality, resurrection or offensive attack.
Panel 1 "01 · Décret posé": narrow vertical amber-gold faceted seal draws itself beside hero shoulder, like a split wax cartouche with one ivory notch. Floating spell object, not equipment. Three stepped gold planes, one ivory edge. Half hero height, face clear. Enemy inactive. No giant aura, temple or deity.
Panel 2 "02 · En attente": large seal GONE, only ONE tiny gold notched token beside hip, at most one tenth hero height. No particles, bubble or halo. Both characters grounded and clear.
Panel 3 "03 · Coup létal évité": adjacent enemy makes one incoming weapon stroke, a thin muted dark arc ending near hero torso. At this instant gold seal expands once, splitting into TWO asymmetric amber plates around torso, with bold warm ivory upward curl of breath between them. Decisive contrast, total effect at most 1.3 hero heights. Hero stays upright, no knockback or revival. No retaliation against enemy. Simple annotation "1 PV" below hero. Small waiting token CONSUMED AND ABSENT. No green healing or restored health bar.
Bottom strip: enlarged notched seal front and side; small endpoint drawing of hero alone with NO token/aura, caption "Sceau consommé". Swatches dark bronze #624330, amber #d89b3d, pale gold #f6d27b, ivory #fff3d5.
Footer "Un seul sauvetage · expire au prochain tour · pression exclue". Divine weight from silhouette and brief ivory fracture, no full-screen flash, wings, angel, skull or literal legal text on seal.
